title: Learnable Splines for Unstructured Neural Operators
abstract: arXiv:2610.22446v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural operators approximate solution operators of partial differential equations at a fraction of the cost of numerical solvers. Efficient grid-based architectures such as the Fourier neural operator (FNO) assume uniform rectangular grids, whereas engineering simulations use large, irregular, and locally refined meshes. We introduce L-SplineFNO, a memory-efficient neural operator that couples an FNO backbone with a sparse, learnable tensor-product B-spline transfer between unstructured meshes and a latent Cartesian grid. A local normalised scatter avoids the geometry-dependent solve of analytic spline transformation while preserving compact support, partition of unity, and spline smoothness by construction. The neural operator, conditioned on global design and operating parameters, learns the mapping of geometry to the field solution. translated_title: 面向非结构化神经算子的可学习样条
translated_abstract: 神经算子以数值求解器的一小部分成本来近似偏微分方程的解算子。诸如傅里叶神经算子（FNO）等高效的基于网格的架构假设均匀的矩形网格，而工程仿真则使用大型、不规则且局部细化的网格。我们提出了 L-SplineFNO，这是一种内存高效的神经算子，它将 FNO 主干与稀疏、可学习的张量积 B 样条变换相结合，实现非结构化网格与潜在笛卡尔网格之间的转换。局部归一化散射避免了依赖于几何形状的解析样条变换求解过程，同时在构造上保持了紧支撑性、单位分解性以及样条平滑性。该神经算子以全局设计和运行参数为条件，学习从几何形状到场解的映射。在六个三维工程基准测试中，L-SplineFNO 在保持强大预测精度的同时（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 L-SplineFNO，通过将 FNO 主干与稀疏可学习的张量积 B 样条变换相结合，实现非结构化工程网格与潜在笛卡尔网格之间内存高效的转换，并在三维工程基准测试中取得优异的预测精度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces L-SplineFNO, a memory-efficient neural operator that couples an FNO backbone with a sparse, learnable tensor-product B-spline transfer between unstructured meshes and a latent Cartesian grid, achieving strong predictive accuracy on six 3D engineering benchmarks.
